reference_question: Summarize the purpose of this document.
user_question: Based on the entire content, summarize the purpose of this document in a few sentences.
answer: This document is a Final Report Amendment form that adds a 14-day repeated dose toxicity study to an existing final report on acute toxicity of cigarette smoke in mice. The amendment addresses the limitation that survival predictions based on single-day exposure may not accurately reflect outcomes over longer periods. It has been approved by Quality Assurance, Research, and Regulatory Affairs directors.
